Find quick answers about Total Security.

What is 360 Total Security?

360 Total Security is an all-in-one security and system optimization app for Windows users, combining virus scanning, ransomware protection, PC cleanup, privacy protection, and network troubleshooting in one client.

Is 360 Total Security free?

The free version includes antivirus and anti-ransomware protection plus secure online shopping. Premium adds Driver Updater, Firewall Protection, Privacy Cleaner, Data Shredder, an ad-free experience, and Priority Support.

Which Windows versions are supported?

The current version supports Windows 10 and later, 64-bit. It does not support x86, Windows 8.1, 8, 7, Vista, XP, or Windows Server.

Do I need a 360 account?

The standard free version can be used without an account. Some membership services may require sign-in.

Download and installation guidance for Windows PCs.

Where can I download 360 Total Security?

Download the current Windows version from the official download page: https://www.360totalsecurity.com/en/download-free-antivirus/.

How do I install Total Security?

Run the downloaded installer, follow the on-screen steps, then open Total Security and complete a first check.

Why can't I install or update it?

Use the latest installer, check your internet connection and close other security installers before trying again.

How do I uninstall Total Security?

Use Windows Settings to remove 360 Total Security from the installed apps list.

Simple explanations of the product and its features.

What is Full Check?

Full Check gives an overview of security, performance and cleanup items in one place.

What does Virus Scan do?

Virus Scan checks selected areas of your PC for potential threats and lets you review the results.

What is Cleanup?

Cleanup identifies temporary files and other removable items, which you can review before deletion.

What is Startup Manager?

Startup Manager shows programs and services that launch with Windows, helping you decide what stays enabled.

More practical answers for everyday PC care.

How do I update virus definitions?

Open Total Security and use its update option to keep protection data current.

How do I submit a suspicious file?

To submit a suspicious file, contact support at https://www.360totalsecurity.com/en/support/how-to/ and include the file details.

How do I contact support?

Visit the support page at https://www.360totalsecurity.com/en/support/how-to/ for help.

How can I adjust notifications or protection settings?

Open Total Security settings to review notification and protection controls available in your version.

Find quick answers about Total Security.

What is 360 Total Security?

360 Total Security is an all-in-one security and system optimization app for Windows users, combining virus scanning, ransomware protection, PC cleanup, privacy protection, and network troubleshooting in one client.

Is 360 Total Security free?

The free version includes antivirus and anti-ransomware protection plus secure online shopping. Premium adds Driver Updater, Firewall Protection, Privacy Cleaner, Data Shredder, an ad-free experience, and Priority Support.

Which Windows versions are supported?

The current version supports Windows 10 and later, 64-bit. It does not support x86, Windows 8.1, 8, 7, Vista, XP, or Windows Server.

Do I need a 360 account?

The standard free version can be used without an account. Some membership services may require sign-in.

Download and installation guidance for Windows PCs.

Where can I download 360 Total Security?

Download the current Windows version from the official download page: https://www.360totalsecurity.com/en/download-free-antivirus/.

How do I install Total Security?

Run the downloaded installer, follow the on-screen steps, then open Total Security and complete a first check.

Why can't I install or update it?

Use the latest installer, check your internet connection and close other security installers before trying again.

How do I uninstall Total Security?

Use Windows Settings to remove 360 Total Security from the installed apps list.

Simple explanations of the product and its features.

What is Full Check?

Full Check gives an overview of security, performance and cleanup items in one place.

What does Virus Scan do?

Virus Scan checks selected areas of your PC for potential threats and lets you review the results.

What is Cleanup?

Cleanup identifies temporary files and other removable items, which you can review before deletion.

What is Startup Manager?

Startup Manager shows programs and services that launch with Windows, helping you decide what stays enabled.

More practical answers for everyday PC care.

How do I update virus definitions?

Open Total Security and use its update option to keep protection data current.

How do I submit a suspicious file?

To submit a suspicious file, contact support at https://www.360totalsecurity.com/en/support/how-to/ and include the file details.

How do I contact support?

Visit the support page at https://www.360totalsecurity.com/en/support/how-to/ for help.

How can I adjust notifications or protection settings?

Open Total Security settings to review notification and protection controls available in your version.
